controllers.name: AccountController
controllers.description:
AccountController exposes account login, reauthentication, and removal to
the frontend. It stays limited to DTO conversion and feature invocation.

methods.name: CancelLogin
methods.description: CancelLogin discards a pending sign-in flow.

methods.name: CompleteTOTP
methods.description: CompleteTOTP finishes a sign-in flow with the user's one-time verification code.

methods.name: ListAccounts
methods.description: ListAccounts returns the launcher's saved accounts for account selection.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Login starts an account sign-in flow and reports whether further verification is required.

methods.name: ReauthenticateAccount
methods.description: ReauthenticateAccount refreshes authentication for an existing saved account.

methods.name: RemoveAccount
methods.description: RemoveAccount removes a saved account and its protected credentials.

methods.name: SetDefaultAccount
methods.description: SetDefaultAccount selects the account used for future game launches.

methods.name: ValidateAccount
methods.description: ValidateAccount checks whether a saved account can still authenticate.

controllers.name: AppController
controllers.description: AppController exposes launcher metadata to the frontend.

methods.name: AppInfo
methods.description: AppInfo returns launcher metadata needed by the application shell.

controllers.name: DeepLinkController
controllers.description: DeepLinkController exposes cold-start deep links after the frontend subscribes.

methods.name: ConsumePendingDeepLinks

controllers.name: GameVersionController
controllers.description:
GameVersionController exposes installed and available game versions and
drives installation and removal. It stays limited to DTO conversion and
feature invocation.

methods.name: InstallLocalVersion
methods.description: InstallLocalVersion imports a game installation from a local archive or directory.

methods.name: InstallVersion
methods.description: InstallVersion starts downloading and installing a selected game release.

methods.name: ListAvailableVersions
methods.description: ListAvailableVersions returns downloadable releases compatible with the current platform.

methods.name: ListInstalledVersions
methods.description: ListInstalledVersions returns game versions installed and managed by the launcher.

methods.name: RemoveVersion
methods.description: RemoveVersion removes an installed game version when no managed instance requires it.

controllers.name: InstanceController

to DTO conversion and feature invocation.

methods.name: CloneInstance
methods.description: CloneInstance creates a new managed instance by copying an existing instance.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: CreateInstance creates an isolated game instance using the requested version and launch settings.

methods.name: DeleteInstance
methods.description: DeleteInstance removes an instance and optionally deletes its data directory.

methods.name: DetectExistingVintageStoryData
methods.description: DetectExistingVintageStoryData finds existing Vintage Story data that can be imported as an instance.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: GetInstance returns one managed instance with its current mod and playtime summary.

methods.name: InspectExistingVintageStoryData
methods.description: InspectExistingVintageStoryData validates a selected data directory and describes its importable contents.

methods.name: ListInstances
methods.description: ListInstances returns all launcher instances visible in the library.

methods.name: SelectInstanceCover
methods.description: SelectInstanceCover prompts for an image to use as an instance cover.

methods.name: SetInstancePinned
methods.description: SetInstancePinned changes whether an instance is pinned in the library.

methods.name: StartExistingDataImport
methods.description: StartExistingDataImport begins importing discovered game data into a managed instance.

methods.name: UpdateInstance
methods.description: UpdateInstance applies editable metadata, account, version, and launch settings to an instance.

controllers.name: InstancePackageController
controllers.description:
InstancePackageController exposes instance package export, inspection, and
import to the frontend. It stays limited to DTO conversion and feature
invocation.

methods.name: ExportInstance
methods.description: ExportInstance writes a portable package containing sanitized instance data and metadata.

methods.name: ImportPackage
methods.description: ImportPackage creates a managed instance from a validated package.

methods.name: InspectPackage
methods.description: InspectPackage validates a package and reports its contents before import.

methods.name: SelectExportPath
methods.description: SelectExportPath prompts for the destination of an exported instance package.

methods.name: SelectPackageFile
methods.description: SelectPackageFile prompts for an instance package to inspect or import.

controllers.name: LastKnownGoodController
controllers.description:
LastKnownGoodController exposes the Last Known Good marker of instances to
the frontend. It stays limited to DTO conversion and feature invocation.

methods.name: GetInstanceLastKnownGood
methods.description:
GetInstanceLastKnownGood returns the Last Known Good marker of an instance
together with the comparison against its current configuration. A zero DTO
with no error means no marker was recorded yet.

controllers.name: LaunchController
controllers.description:
LaunchController exposes launch validation, game start/stop, and running
instance queries to the frontend. It stays limited to DTO conversion and
feature invocation.

methods.name: ForceStopInstance
methods.description: ForceStopInstance terminates a running game or server process immediately.

methods.name: GetRunningInstances
methods.description: GetRunningInstances returns identifiers for instances with active game or server processes.

methods.name: LaunchInstance
methods.description: LaunchInstance starts the game client with the instance's account and launch settings.

methods.name: LaunchServer
methods.description: LaunchServer starts the dedicated server for an instance with the requested arguments.

methods.name: StopInstance
methods.description: StopInstance requests a graceful stop of a running game or server process.

methods.name: ValidateLaunch
methods.description: ValidateLaunch checks whether an instance can start and reports blocking problems.

controllers.name: LauncherUpdateController
controllers.description:
LauncherUpdateController exposes launcher update checks and installation to
the frontend. It stays limited to DTO conversion and feature invocation.

methods.name: CheckUpdates
methods.description: CheckUpdates checks the selected release channel for a newer launcher version.

methods.name: CurrentVersion
methods.description: CurrentVersion returns the running launcher version for display and update comparison.

methods.name: InstallUpdate
methods.description: InstallUpdate downloads and applies the newest update from the selected channel.

methods.name: OpenReleasePage
methods.description: OpenReleasePage opens the selected update channel's release page.

methods.name: OpenUrl
methods.description:
OpenUrl opens an http(s) link in the user's default browser. Only well-formed
web links are accepted; any other scheme or a missing host is rejected.

controllers.name: LogController
controllers.description:
LogController exposes the launcher's in-memory log console and lets the user
export the recent logs plus a system summary for support.

methods.name: ExportLogs
methods.description:
ExportLogs asks the user for a destination and writes a support log file
containing a system summary and the recent launcher log. It returns the
saved path, or an empty string when the user cancels the dialog. Sensitive
values never reach the file: the log buffer is redacted on write and the
summary carries no credentials or machine-specific paths.

methods.name: ListLogs
methods.description:
ListLogs returns the most recent log lines rendered for the console. The
newest lines come last. Lines are ANSI-colored so an xterm-style viewer can
display them directly.

methods.name: OpenLogsDirectory
methods.description:
OpenLogsDirectory opens the launcher's rolling log directory in the native
file manager, creating it when needed.

methods.name: WriteLog
methods.description:
WriteLog routes a log entry reported from the frontend into the launcher's
logging pipeline (in-memory console, live push, session file, support
export). The level must be one of "debug", "info", "warn" or "error";
messages are length-capped and sensitive values are redacted like any other
log line. Attrs are attached as key/value pairs; the entry is marked with
source=frontend so UI-originated lines are distinguishable.

controllers.name: ModCatalogController
controllers.description:
ModCatalogController exposes ModDB browsing, catalog downloads, and
downloaded-mod management to the frontend. It stays limited to DTO
conversion and feature invocation.

methods.name: CancelModTask
methods.description: CancelModTask requests cancellation of an active catalog download or upload.

methods.name: CheckModUpdates
methods.description: CheckModUpdates refreshes update information for cached releases of one catalog mod.

methods.name: DownloadMod
methods.description: DownloadMod downloads a catalog release and optionally installs it into selected instances.

methods.name: DownloadModsBatch
methods.description: DownloadModsBatch downloads and installs several catalog releases for one instance.

methods.name: GetMod
methods.description: GetMod returns catalog details and available versions for one mod.

methods.name: InstallDownloadedMod
methods.description: InstallDownloadedMod installs an already cached catalog release into selected instances.

methods.name: ListDownloadedMods
methods.description: ListDownloadedMods returns catalog mod files cached by the launcher.

methods.name: ListModTags
methods.description: ListModTags returns catalog tags with their current result counts.

methods.name: PreviewUnusedDownloadedMods
methods.description: PreviewUnusedDownloadedMods reports cached mod files that are not used by any instance.

methods.name: RemoveDownloadedMod
methods.description: RemoveDownloadedMod deletes a cached catalog release when it is safe to remove.

methods.name: RemoveUnusedDownloadedMods
methods.description: RemoveUnusedDownloadedMods deletes cached mod files that are not used by any instance.

methods.name: SearchMods
methods.description: SearchMods queries the public mod catalog with filters, compatibility checks, and pagination.

methods.name: UploadMods
methods.description: UploadMods uploads selected local mod archives to the catalog service.

controllers.name: ModManagerController
controllers.description:
ModManagerController exposes installed-mod management to the frontend. It
stays limited to DTO conversion and feature invocation.

methods.name: CheckInstanceModUpdates
methods.description: CheckInstanceModUpdates finds compatible catalog updates for managed mods in an instance.

methods.name: GetModDeletePreview
methods.description: GetModDeletePreview reports dependent mods that would be affected by removal.

methods.name: InstallModFile
methods.description: InstallModFile installs one local mod archive into an instance.

methods.name: InstallModFiles
methods.description: InstallModFiles installs several local mod archives and reports individual failures.

methods.name: LinkLocalMods
methods.description: LinkLocalMods links compatible cached mod files into an instance.

methods.name: ListInstalledMods
methods.description: ListInstalledMods returns mods installed in an instance and their enabled state.

methods.name: RemoveMod
methods.description: RemoveMod removes an installed mod and optionally its dependent mods.

methods.name: SetModEnabled
methods.description: SetModEnabled enables or disables an installed mod for its owning instance.

methods.name: SetModUpdatePolicy
methods.description: SetModUpdatePolicy changes how a managed mod participates in automatic updates.

methods.name: UpdateInstanceMods
methods.description:
UpdateInstanceMods updates several installed mods of one instance in a
single coordinated operation; the backend creates exactly one automatic
safety snapshot before the first update is applied.

controllers.name: NewsController

methods.name: Sync

methods.name: UpdateSettings
